items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: I had the opportunity to do a recording with Stephane Grapelli.

ctx.x: Now, when you were traveling over there, did you play under -- what circumstances did you tend to perform under? Were you playing clubs or concert halls or festivals or all of them?

Concert halls, festivals and on one occasion, we played nightclub. Of course, getting back to the recording part, I had -- was a wonderful feeling -- I had the opportunity to do a recording with Stephane Grapelli. Have you heard that name?
